preconditions.description: The length of the array n is between 3 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element a_i in the array is between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'YES' if all(a_i == a[0] for a_i in a) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if all elements in the array can be made equal using the given operations, otherwise 'NO'.
If the output is 'YES', the number of operations m is between 0 and n.

postconditions.expression: if return_value == 'YES': all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= n and 1 <= k <= n and len({i, j, k}) == 3 for i, j, k in operations)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', each operation consists of three distinct indices between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: if return_value == 'YES': all(a[i-1] ^ a[j-1] ^ a[k-1] == a[i-1] for i, j, k in operations)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', each operation correctly updates the array elements using the XOR operation.
